documents.title: Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Visiting Hours
documents.markdown:
# Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Visiting Hours

## Weekday visits
Visitors are welcome between 12:00 and 21:00 on weekdays. Each patient may receive at most 4 visitors at the same time.

## Intensive care
Intensive care visits are limited to 11 minutes and one visitor at a time. Visitors must wear the gown provided at the unit door.

## Children
Children under 12 may visit only together with an adult. Flowers and food from outside are not allowed in patient rooms.

documents.title: Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Laboratory Results
documents.markdown:
# Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Laboratory Results

## Turnaround times
Routine blood test results are ready within 9 hours. Culture results take up to 4 days.

## Online access
Results are published on the patient portal, protected by a 6-digit code sent by SMS. The code expires after 7 minutes.

## Critical values
Critical values are telephoned to the requesting physician within 39 minutes. Patients are not informed by SMS about critical values.

documents.title: Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Appointment Cancellation
documents.markdown:
# Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Appointment Cancellation

## Notice period
Appointments must be cancelled at least 39 hours in advance. Cancellations can be made by phone or on the patient portal.

## Missed appointments
After 2 missed appointments, online booking is suspended for 55 days. Emergency care is never refused because of missed appointments.

documents.title: Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Fees and Payment
documents.markdown:
# Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Fees and Payment

## Private examination
A private examination costs 1.540 TL. The fee is paid at the registration desk before the examination.

## Medical reports
A medical report costs 760 TL and is issued within 3 working days.

## Payment methods
Payments are accepted by card and bank transfer. Card payments in up to 6 instalments are possible.

documents.title: Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Pharmacy
documents.markdown:
# Maviliman Physiotherapy Centre — Pharmacy

## Opening hours
The in-house pharmacy is open from 9:00 to 17:00 every day. It is closed on the first day of religious holidays.

## Prescriptions
Electronic prescriptions can be collected within 7 days of issue. A prescription number and an identity document are required.
